message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crime(s) based on facts. Facts: Defendant repeatedly smashed hotel property, causing damage valued 3166 yuan. This is property damage. In Chinese criminal law, that is "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional destruction of property). The correction rules mention forging, remote locking etc, not relevant. So we assign the crime: 故意毁坏财物. The format: [罪名]故意毁坏财物<eoa>. Need JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
